title: Send emails with AI Inbx
description: Send email from your domains or connected Gmail and Outlook mailboxes, and follow up in the same thread, schedule it, or draft it for review.

environment.name: AI_INBX_API_KEY
environment.description: An API key from aiinbx.com/app with the sending scope. Keep it server-side.

environment.name: AI_INBX_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: A random token of at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32, that callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Neon Function URLs are public, so the function requires it.

operations.title: Send an email
operations.description: Sends an AI Inbx send request with from, to, subject, and html or text. Add thread_id to follow up, scheduled_at to send later, or draft to hold the email for review.
